turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help with my upcoming flight. I thought I added insurance to my booking, but when I check online, it’s not showing up. I’m flying with my family and everyone else has insurance, so I really want to make sure I have it too. Can you help me sort this out?

I understand your concern about travel insurance for your upcoming flight. To assist you, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for your booking. Could you please provide those details? If you’re not sure about your reservation ID, just let me know your user ID and I can help locate it.

Sure, my user ID is sophia_taylor_9065 and the reservation number is PEP4E0. Can you please check why the insurance isn’t showing up for me? I really want to make sure I have it like the rest of my family.

I’ve checked your reservation (PEP4E0) and currently, travel insurance is not included for your booking. According to our policy, travel insurance can only be added at the time of the initial booking and cannot be added afterward.

Unfortunately, I’m unable to add insurance to your reservation at this stage. If you have any other questions or need assistance with something else regarding your flight, please let me know.

That’s really frustrating, because I was sure I added insurance when I booked. My whole family has it, and I need to have the same coverage as them. Isn’t there any way you can help me add insurance to my flight? I really don’t want to travel without it.

I understand how important it is to have the same coverage as your family. However, according to our policy, travel insurance cannot be added after the initial booking is completed. This restriction applies to all reservations, and I do not have the ability to override it.

If you have any other concerns or need help with your reservation, please let me know. If you would like to discuss this further, I can transfer you to a human agent for additional assistance. Would you like me to do that?

No, I really don’t want to be transferred. I just want to have the same insurance as my family. Isn’t there anything you can do? Maybe there’s an exception or a way to escalate this? I really need to have insurance for my flight.

I understand how important this is to you, and I truly wish I could help further. However, I am required to follow the policy, which does not allow adding travel insurance after the initial booking under any circumstances. There are no exceptions or escalation options available through this system.

If you have any other requests regarding your reservation, such as modifying flights, baggage, or passenger information, I am here to help. If you change your mind and would like to speak with a human agent for further discussion, please let me know.

I really appreciate your help, but I just can’t accept traveling without insurance when everyone else in my family has it. Are you absolutely sure there’s no way to add it, even if I pay extra or make some kind of change to my booking? I really need to have insurance for peace of mind.

I completely understand your concern and your desire for peace of mind while traveling. However, I must confirm that, according to our policy, travel insurance cannot be added to a reservation after the initial booking—regardless of payment or making changes to the booking. This rule applies to all customers and there are no exceptions or workarounds available through this system.

If you would like, I can transfer you to a human agent who may be able to provide further assistance or discuss your situation in more detail. Please let me know if you would like to proceed with that option, or if there is anything else I can help you with regarding your reservation.

I really don’t want to be transferred, I just want to have the same insurance as my family. Isn’t there anything else you can do at all? Maybe you could check with a supervisor or see if there’s another way? I just want to make sure I’m covered.

I understand how important this is to you, and I truly want to help. However, I am required to follow the policy, which strictly does not allow adding travel insurance after the initial booking. There is no option for me to check with a supervisor or make exceptions within this system.

If you change your mind and would like to be transferred to a human agent for further discussion, please let me know. Otherwise, if you need help with any other aspect of your reservation, I am here to assist.

I understand, but I really need to have insurance for my flight. If there’s absolutely nothing you can do, can you at least confirm that my family members on the same reservation definitely have their insurance? I want to make sure they’re covered, even if I’m not.

Your reservation (PEP4E0) only lists you, Sophia Taylor, as the passenger, and there is no travel insurance included for this booking. If your family members are traveling under separate reservations, I do not have access to their booking details unless you provide their reservation numbers or user IDs.

If you can provide the reservation numbers or user IDs for your family members, I can check their insurance status for you. Please let me know how you’d like to proceed.
Oh, I see. I thought we were all on the same reservation. Let me check with them and get their reservation numbers. Can I get back to you with that information?

Absolutely! You can get back to me anytime with your family members’ reservation numbers or user IDs, and I’ll be happy to check their insurance status for you. If you have any other questions or need assistance with your own reservation in the meantime, just let me know.
Thank you, I’ll reach out again once I have their details. I appreciate your help.###STOP###
